claim:mosaic_amine_crossfeeding.proposition: A biogenic-amine cross-feeding loop (Gardnerella amines inhibit Lactobacillus and suppress lactate; Lactobacillus degrades amines and acidifies) makes the vaginal community bistable — a protective acidic Lactobacillus state versus a Gardnerella-dominant BV state with a ~mM amine pool.

claim:mosaic_onecarbon_cycle.proposition: Estradiol activation of CBS (transsulfuration) makes hepatic homocysteine vary inversely with estradiol over the menstrual cycle — lowest at the ovulatory E2 peak — reproducing Kim, Nijhout & Reed 2021 on the curated Reed2004 methionine-cycle model.

narrative.question:
Can mechanistic models recreated from the women's-health / bacterial-vaginosis
literature reproduce their source papers' quantitative claims inside the MOSAIC
process-bigraph composition framework?

units.proposition: A biogenic-amine cross-feeding loop (Gardnerella amines inhibit Lactobacillus and suppress lactate; Lactobacillus degrades amines and acidifies) makes the vaginal community bistable — a protective acidic Lactobacillus state versus a Gardnerella-dominant BV state with a ~mM amine pool.

Estradiol activation of CBS (transsulfuration) makes hepatic homocysteine vary inversely with estradiol over the menstrual cycle — lowest at the ovulatory E2 peak — reproducing Kim, Nijhout & Reed 2021 on the curated Reed2004 methionine-cycle model.

decisions.title: Calibrate the amine cross-feeding model to a clinical vaginal time series (e.g. Song 2020, PRJNA637322) to map the bistability boundary quantitatively?
decisions.detail: The bistability is demonstrated under one illustrative parameterisation but not fitted to data.

decisions.title: Extend the one-carbon recreation to the full Kim 2021 19-ODE network (add the folate cycle + PEMT g(E2) / TS-DHFR u(E2) effects) for a higher-fidelity port?
decisions.detail: The current study recreates the methionine-cycle core with folate pools clamped.
